# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: NCY 1970 effects — scripted effects.
## COLDWAR | Cyprus 1970 | Generated by tools/cyprus_1970/compile.py.
## Edit generator/rules, not generated output. English localisation only.

COLDWAR_NCY_1970_update_leadership_epoch = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				date < 1973.2.28
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 2 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				date < 1970.12.27
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					date < 1976.10.31
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				date < 1976.3.18
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					date < 1983.11.6
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						date < 1987.1.1
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 3 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch = 4 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_NCY_1970_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = NCY
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NCY_1970_initialized }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NCY_1970_initialized
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NCY_1970_human_seat_reserved
		if = {
			limit = {
				# A direct preview snapshot can set the slot before the full MD party arrays exist.
				OR = { NOT = { has_variable = ruling_party } NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_1970_historical_politics } }
			}
			IMP_1970_profile_democratic_conservative = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_character = NCY_sezai_ozturk
			}
			retire_character = NCY_sezai_ozturk
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_character = NCY_secme_akin
			}
			retire_character = NCY_secme_akin
		}
		COLDWAR_NCY_1970_refresh_roster = yes
		COLDWAR_NCY_1970_set_leader = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_NCY_1970_daily_tick = {
	COLDWAR_NCY_1970_initialize = yes
	COLDWAR_NCY_1970_refresh_roster = yes
	COLDWAR_NCY_1970_update_leadership_epoch = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NCY_1970_leader_roster_v1 } NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_leader_party = ruling_party } } }
		}
		COLDWAR_NCY_1970_set_leader = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_NCY_1970_select_contemporary_leadership = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = NCY
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_NCY_1970_leader_epoch = COLDWAR_NCY_1970_current_epoch } }
		}
		COLDWAR_NCY_1970_set_leader = yes
	}
}
